subject: Targeted SOC 2 evidence request — time-synced auth traces & MFA failover metrics
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@clearpathhealth.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: audit@clearpath-compliance.com
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II - targeted evidence request: authn traces & MFA failover metrics

Diego,

Thank you again for the scope call this morning. ClearPath's audit team has a few narrow-scope follow-ups so we can complete the authn/control testing for your SOC 2 Type II. We're looking to avoid a full log dump — instead we need tightly-scoped, time-synchronized artifacts that map to the test window. Can you provide the following by EOD Tuesday (2026-05-12)?

1) Time-synced authentication traces (start/end timestamps in UTC) for the period 2025-10-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-03-31T23:59:59Z. We need request-level IDs (SAML request_id / auth_request_id) and the pseudonymized user identifier (hash or token) so ClearPath can correlate across systems without receiving PII. CSV preferred; include header row.

2) MFA failover and recovery metrics for the same period: count of MFA failures leading to account lock, number of breakglass (emergency) OTP resets, and any automated fallback events (SMS -> email, backup codes). An aggregated PDF summary plus the underlying raw counts.

3) Targeted SAML assertion traces for 6 request_ids we'll send in a follow-up email. We only need the assertion timestamps, issuer, subject (pseudonymized), and assertion validity periods.

4) Emergency access (privileged) entries: the list of admin sessions initiated with the emergency policy, including start/end times, who approved the session (internal), and reason codes. Redact user emails and map to pseudonymized IDs.

If Redwood can provide these artifacts with a matching prefix/ID schema (so ClearPath can stitch logs across GAIA auth->token service->session store), that will be sufficient for our control tests. Also include a short note on time synchronization (NTP drift tolerance) and the canonical timezone used for each system.

Attachments: requested_scope_template.xlsx (fill and return)

Thanks,
Maria
Maria Gonzalez
Lead IT Audit, ClearPath Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@clearpathhealth.com>, audit@clearpath-compliance.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II - targeted evidence request: authn traces & MFA failover metrics

Maria / ClearPath team —

Appreciate the clear list. We're comfortable providing a pseudonymized mapping and time-synced traces; that approach aligns with our internal privacy policy. A few clarifications so we scope extracts correctly: 

- For (1) authn traces: are you OK with pseudonymization via HMAC-SHA256 using a shared salt (we can provide the salted hash values and keep the salt internal)? If not, we can provide a one-way hash table with a tokenized prefix.
- For MFA failover metrics (2): do you want event-level rows or just daily aggregates? We can deliver both but need to know the level of detail for sampling.
- For (3): please send the 6 request_ids you want; I'll ask the infra team to pull assertion traces (we log SAML response/request ids in our token-service).
- For emergency access (4): our approval flow is recorded in the privileged-access store; we will redact emails and provide approver internal names (e.g., laura.bennett) and pseudonymized IDs. Are approver names acceptable for your evidence?

Delivery plan (proposed):
- Tue 2026-05-12 10:00 PDT: CSV with authn traces (headers: timestamp_utc, request_id, pseudonym_id, auth_result, source_service)
- Tue 2026-05-12 12:00 PDT: PDF summary of MFA failover counts + raw daily counts CSV
- Tue 2026-05-12 15:00 PDT: SAML assertion short-sample CSV for the 6 request_ids you send
- Tue 2026-05-12 16:00 PDT: Emergency access redacted list

I'll coordinate with Karthik and Laura to make sure we preserve canonical time mapping; our services are NTP-synced to pool.ntp.org with max observed drift < 500ms across services (we'll include a time-sync note).

Attachments: none yet — will attach extracts as separate files in the Drive link.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

From: audit@clearpath-compliance.com <audit@clearpath-compliance.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II - targeted evidence request: authn traces & MFA failover metrics

Diego —

Thanks, that plan works. A couple of quick answers/requests: 

- Pseudonymization: HMAC-SHA256 with a per-customer salt is fine. ClearPath will not request the salt. Please include the algorithm note in the metadata CSV.
- MFA metrics: we need event-level rows for any failure events that resulted in either account lock or a breakglass reset; aggregated daily counts are helpful but not sufficient.
- Approver names: names are okay, but please also include the approver's role (e.g., "IAM Admin") so we can validate segregation of duties.

We will send the 6 request_ids in a separate email within 2 hours. If you hit any blocking issues on internal approvals to extract the privileged session audit, loop in your GRC lead.

Attached: small template explaining the preferred CSV columns (we'll attach via Drive link).

Maria (on behalf of ClearPath Audit)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: audit@clearpath-compliance.com, maria.gonzalez@clearpathhealth.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II - targeted evidence request: authn traces & MFA failover metrics

Maria / ClearPath Audit —

Delivered per the plan: attaching the three artifacts to the shared Drive folder and dropping the links below. Summary of contents: 

- clearpath_authn_traces_20251001_20260331.csv (CSV, header: timestamp_utc, request_id, pseudonym_id, auth_result, source_service, latency_ms)
- mfa_failover_summary_20251001_20260331.pdf (PDF summary) and mfa_failover_counts_daily_20251001_20260331.csv (daily raw counts + event rows for failures leading to lock/reset)
- saml_requestid_sample.csv (the 6 request_ids you provided with assertion timestamps and pseudonymized subject IDs)
- emergency_access_redacted.csv (admin_session_id, start_utc, end_utc, approver_name, approver_role, reason_code)

Notes: 
- Pseudonymization uses HMAC-SHA256 with a per-customer salt (algorithm: HMAC-SHA256, salt not shared).
- Time sync: all timestamps are UTC; services are NTP-synced (pool.ntp.org). Max observed drift across token-service and session-store during the period = 432 ms (we include a short drift log extract).

Drive: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/teams/compliance/ClearPath/evidence_20260512
ClearPath job link: https://app.clearpath-audit.com/jobs/9876/attachments

If you need a different format or additional correlation keys, let us know and we can extract a small sample for validation.

Attachments: clearpath_requested_scope.xlsx, saml_requestid_sample.csv, mfa_failover_summary.pdf

Diego
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
